artifacts.purpose: Secondary taxonomic and strategic map relating digital-visibility practices and positioning DIO as a proposed entity-level meta-layer, without presenting the map as empirical validation.

term_rationales.artificial intelligence: The map explicitly concerns AI-mediated environments and the retrieval, synthesis, attribution, and recommendation of entities and claims by AI systems.
term_rationales.knowledge graphs: Knowledge graphs are explicitly included among the entity-recognition and structured-relationship practices mapped by the presentation.
term_rationales.human observers: The map explicitly distinguishes human-facing interpretation from technical and AI-mediated reconstruction.
term_rationales.taxonomy of digital optimization practic: The page presents a taxonomic overview relating SEO, AEO, GEO, LLMO, AIO, Entity SEO, and DIO.
term_rationales.AI-mediated visibility: AI-mediated discovery, retrieval, synthesis, attribution, and recommendation are explicit parts of the map's scope.
term_rationales.entity-based visibility: The map positions DIO around the coherence, recognizability, attribution, and continuity of a digital entity rather than only a page or answer.
term_rationales.strategic meta-layer: The page explicitly characterizes DIO as a proposed strategic meta-layer within a wider taxonomy, not as the name of the whole field.
term_rationales.distributed representational state: The page describes entities as distributed across pages, profiles, databases, citations, structured data, platforms, and AI-generated responses.
term_rationales.semantic coherence: The central DIO positioning is the coherence of an entity's distributed representation across human, technical, and AI-mediated contexts.
term_rationales.entity resolution: The page explicitly relates optimization fragmentation to entity resolution.
term_rationales.Semantic Fragmentation: The page names semantic fragmentation as a failure risk arising from incompatible or disconnected distributed records.
term_rationales.Temporal Discontinuity: The page explicitly names temporal discontinuity as a risk when entities change but indexes, datasets, and summaries retain older states.
term_rationales.Identity Collapse: The page explicitly names identity collapse as a risk caused by ambiguity, weak distinction, and conflation.
term_rationales.Semantic Vulnerability: The page explicitly names semantic vulnerability as susceptibility to unverified, conflicting, or manipulated context.
term_rationales.provenance: The map explicitly relates its diagnosis to provenance and identifies provenance among the relevant DIO/ODI dimensions.
